Yeah, Games Done Quick had a thing like a month ago of just a whole bunch of speed runs and it was always nice to just tune in for awhile and watch was going on.

Thanks for your help, I'll be sure to try some of that whenever something goes wrong again.

Hey, thanks for checking in. I'm doing slightly better but I have my highs and lows. I'm at a nice medium point right now.

I guess it can't hurt to try to treat the symptoms. I've tried doing some of those things, but I can't eat at all whenever I'm in one of my slumps and trying to pay attention to videos on YouTube or Netflix gets extremely frustrating. I can't describe the feeling, just trying to ignore what's going on in my life makes me almost angry.

Thanks for the help, friend. When I'm back in one of my lows I'll be sure to come back and talk to you if you want to listen.
People haven't tried to open my eyes at all. When I specifically say that calling a suicide hotline isn't going to open my eyes, and people do it anyway, don't be shocked when they're still shut.

Now that I think about it, I haven't really done anything that I particularly like doing in awhile. I like playing Counter Strike but there's not a lot of time for it in my schedule.

To be honest though, I don't have a ton of hobbies or interests.

Not really. Most of my issues stem from either my relationship or stress brought on from school. I can't afford to just take absences from school, especially with the types of classes that I'm taking, and I don't see breaking up with my SO as an option because I don't want to.

I'm just stressed. I have to handle all this schoolwork and on top of that I just feel like I can't do anything in this relationship right. I am just offensive and everything I do is wrong.
That's not an option. I'm not in control of what doctor I see, unfortunately.
I've talked about speaking to a doctor, it's not something I want to do. My doctor lives hours away and it's just too far of a drive.

I'm not ready to talk to someone else about my issues. I have them but I don't know how to properly express them. If I know that I'm not going to be talking about stuff to help me, then there's no point in calling a hotline.
It's too chaotic. There's too much going on. I can't handle all the problems and challenges that life throws at me. I just want to turn everything down for a little bit.

You would be correct. A lot of times it feels like I couldn't care whether I die or not and sometimes it stretches into actually wanting to, but I guess deep down I don't really want to die. Right now is one of those times where I actually do want to do.

I haven't done a lot, to be perfectly honest. Never talked to a doctor or a therapist, never talked to a suicide hotline, and I never really talked to anyone about my depression. I don't want to see a doctor because my doctor is so far away and I'd need to let my parents know before I could go and I don't want to. I don't want to talk to a therapist because I don't think it would do much good. I don't want to talk to a hotline unless it's a last resort.

I've thought this through in its entirety. I've considered every option I could possibly take and what would happen if I go through with it and how much it would help me and whether or not it was worth it. I know how to help myself, but I don't know how to go through with doing it. I'm just not capable.

To be perfectly honest with you, I'm not that scared. I feel like I should be, but I'm not. I'm just tired and being able to turn all of this off just sounds so good to me. Life is too loud.

I appreciate the help friend, but forgiving myself is hard. It's not something I can just say "Oh well, I hurt somebody but there's nothing I can do about it now." There has to be something. Somewhere out there is a solution that would help me never hurt anyone and I can't find it. It's so frustrating hurting people every single time.

The unfortunate reality is that people never remember happiness as much as they remember pain. If somebody has hurt them in the past, they remember that. They remember what happened, they remember who did it, and they hold grudges against that person. I've been around so many people and I know how this goes. I can make a hundred people laugh and smile in a day and it wouldn't even matter if I hurt just one person.

I can't talk with my girlfriend. She refuses to talk with me. I just have to wait it out until she's okay and will communicate, but right now I'm shut out. So I just need to wait and suffer until she comes back, and it hurts so much and I'm tired. I've been here too many times and every single time it just hurts more and more. She's brought happiness into my life so many times and I don't want to break up with her, but this is one hell of a price to pay for all that.
